2Download the Excel template

The template already carries a column for every team you chose. Type each pupil once, then write Yes under every team that pupil will play in.

What the template contains S/N, Full Name, Gender, Date of Birth, Class, Parent Contact — then one column for each of your teams, plus a Guide sheet inside the file. It holds 200 ready rows.
The template checks the work for you
ColumnWhat happens as they type
GenderDrop-down list — only M or F is accepted
Date of BirthMust be a real past date. Shows as DD/MM/YYYY
ClassDrop-down list — B1 to B9
Parent ContactKeeps the first 0. Warns if it is not 10–14 digits
Every teamDrop-down list — only Yes or No is accepted
Tell your teachers Click a cell and a small arrow appears — tap it and pick from the list instead of typing. Do not change the heading row and do not delete a column.

On a phone you can open the template with Google Sheets, WPS Office or Microsoft Excel. The CSV has no drop-down lists and no Guide sheet — use it only if the Excel file will not open on your device.

3Import the filled Excel file

Choose the file you filled in. The system will read it, check it, and put each pupil into every team marked Yes.

4Add passport photographs

There are four ways to do this, and you can mix them freely. Pick whichever suits how your photographs were taken.

The four ways 1. Take them now, pupil by pupil, with the camera.
2. Photographs already taken, in the same order as the list.
3. Photographs whose file names carry the pupils' names.
4. One pupil at a time, by hand — at the bottom of this page.
No pupils captured yet.

Way 1 — Take the photographs now

Best on a phone. The system shows you one pupil at a time and opens your camera. The photograph is joined to that pupil at once, so nothing has to be named and nothing can be mixed up.

Every photograph must have a plain white background A phone photograph taken in the school compound will not. Take the photographs here first, save them out with the button below, whiten them in bulk with the EduLinkGH Batch Photo Editor, then bring them back in through Way 3. Because each file is saved under the pupil's own name, they will match by themselves on the way back.

Save the photographs onto this device

Every photograph is saved under the pupil's own name, inside one folder named after the school and the team. Upload that folder to the EduLinkGH editor to whiten the backgrounds in one go.

After whitening Bring the edited photographs back with Way 3 below. Do not rename the files — the names are what join each photograph to its pupil.

Way 2 — Photographs already taken, in order

If the photographs were taken in the same order as your list — even with camera names like IMG_20261108_143022.jpg — choose them all here. The system will pair them in order and show you the pairing to check before anything is saved.

Print the calling list first Use the button in Way 1. One teacher calls the names in order while another takes the photographs. Then the order will be right.

Way 3 — Photographs named after the pupils

If each file already carries the pupil's name, pick them all and the system will match them by itself.

or drag the photos here

Photos not the right size or background?

You can bulk-edit all your passport photographs — crop, straighten and set a clean background — with the EduLinkGH Batch Photo Editor. This is a paid service.

Open the EduLinkGH Photo Editor
www.edulinkgh.com/tools/photo-editor.html — needs internet.

Way 4 — One pupil at a time

Every pupil is listed below. Use Add photo to pick or take a photograph for that one pupil. This is the simplest way when a school already knows its own pupils, and it is also how you fix any photograph that went to the wrong person.

5Photo albums, team by team

Each album has 12 pupils on an A4 sheet, with the screening boxes beside every photograph and the headteacher's signature block on every page.

Remember Print each album in colour, and make three (3) copies — one for the Organiser, one for the Games / Activity Coordinators, and one for the school.

6General Team Sheet

One sheet for the whole contingent, showing name, gender, date of birth, age, class, parent contact and the teams each pupil plays in.

Remember The team sheet must also be signed and stamped by the headteacher, and presented in three (3) copies.

How to use this system

  1. School — fill in the school and headteacher details, then tick every team the school will enter.
  2. Excel Template — download it and fill in your pupils. Write Yes under each team a pupil plays in.
  3. Import Students — bring the filled file back into the system.
  4. Photos — add each pupil's passport photograph.
  5. Albums — download the album for each team and print it in colour.
  6. Team Sheet — download the general team sheet and print it.

Putting it on a phone

Does it need internet?

No. After you have saved this page on your phone or computer it works completely offline. Only the EduLinkGH photo editor link needs internet.

Where is my work saved?

Inside this device's browser. If you clear your browser data, your work will be lost — so download your PDFs as soon as they are ready. Use the backup buttons below to keep a copy.

Can I work on more than one school?

Yes. Go to the School tab and add as many schools as you need. Switch between them at any time.

Clear everything on this device

Removes every school, every pupil and every photograph kept by this app on this phone or computer. Use it when you are handing the device on, or when you want to begin a fresh season.

Save a backup first Once this is done there is no way to bring the work back, unless you have a backup file. Use the Save a backup file button above.

Photo editing

To crop and clean up many passport photographs at once, use the EduLinkGH Batch Photo Editor at www.edulinkgh.com/tools/photo-editor.html. It is a paid service and needs internet.
